<b>Strengthening Songclave</b> is a [[Donate Wishes|Donate Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, found on the Wishwall of [[Songclave]]. 

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, donate {{R|500}} to the Songclave Wishwall. <i>Strengthening Songclave</i> is a prerequisite Wish required to unlock <i>[[The Lost Merchant]]</i> and <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> Wishes.
